memo:
PRIORITIES: T1 play Overgrown Tomb untapped only if casting nothing; otherwise tapped is fine, since no 1-drop is needed. Pay life untapped only for Wayfarer's Bauble? Just play Tomb tapped. T2 Underground Sea, cast Wayfarer's Bauble, then activate it T3 to ramp toward Muldrotha on T5. Play Spore Frog early as a blocker and a future recurring Fog. Doc Aurlock when mana spares.
THREAT: Sauron (P1) and Sephiroth (P2) are drain and aristocrat engines, so watch for sacrifice fodder. Y'shtola (P3) is a drain deck too. Nobody has a board yet.
HOLD: Seal of Primordium for a Sol Ring or signet engine, or a key enchantment. Kaya's Ghostform goes on Muldrotha later. Coming of Galactus waits for mid-game.

PRIORITIES: Play Tropical Island now (untapped, keeps Woodland Cemetery untapped later). Cast Ratchet Bomb this turn at 0, then tick it up. Aim it at 1 to hit P3's Sol Ring, which is their fastest acceleration. Turn 3: Woodland Cemetery, then Cryogen Relic or Plaguecrafter. Stock the graveyard for an early Muldrotha around turn 5–6.
THREAT: P3 Giada (angels, go-wide, ramping off Sol Ring) is the early leader. P2 Hearthhull (land sacrifice value) and P1 Teval (graveyard) are also dangerous. Watch for graveyard hate from Teval.
HOLD: Keep Counterspell for a board wipe, graveyard exile, or a bomb. Save Twisted Embrace for a real threat. Hold Barrin until the mana is spare.

PRIORITIES: This turn, play Swamp and cast Sol Ring. Next turn, play Zagoth Triome tapped (nothing castable anyway). Turn after, play Forest and cast Braids or Syr Konrad, using Swamp, the Triome and Sol Ring for BB. Then play Island and cast Muldrotha on schedule: 4 lands plus Sol Ring makes 6 mana. Cast Doc Aurlock once G and U are both up and mana is spare.

THREAT: P3 Edgar Markov goes wide with vampires and eminence makes tokens even with Edgar uncast; save removal for their anthem or engine. P2 Giada angels come next.

HOLD: Don't sacrifice to Braids early. Keep Syr Konrad for when the graveyard lanes start churning.

PRIORITIES: Play Woodland Cemetery (it enters untapped because Tropical Island is a Forest). Cast Ratchet Bomb now. Tick it to 1 on each of our turns, then pop it to destroy both Sol Rings (P2's and P3's). Next turn, play Marsh Flats and fetch a Swamp. Then cast Cryogen Relic, or Plaguecrafter if Giada has spread creatures. Get to 6 mana for Muldrotha, and get Relic and Bomb into the graveyard first.
THREAT: P3 Giada is the leader: an angel go-wide deck with Sol Ring. P2 Hearthhull has Sol Ring and Zuran Orb. P1 Teval can exile graveyards.
HOLD: Keep Counterspell for a wrath, graveyard exile, or a big angel. Save Twisted Embrace for a key angel or Hearthhull. Hold Barrin until mana is spare.

PRIORITIES: Play Underground Sea. Cast Seal of Primordium now (1G) and leave it on the battlefield. Next turn, cast Wayfarer's Bauble plus Spore Frog, then crack the Bauble the following turn to ramp toward Muldrotha. Doc Aurlock only when mana is otherwise unused. Grist comes after Muldrotha is ready, through the planeswalker or creature lane.

THREAT: P2's Skullclamp is the table's best draw engine, especially with Sephiroth sacrifices. Sacrifice the Seal to destroy it in response to its first equip activation, or at P2's end step if P2 has creatures. Sauron (P1) is the next priority.

HOLD: Kaya's Ghostform is for Muldrotha. Coming of Galactus waits for the midgame. Save the Spore Frog fog for a lethal or big combat swing.

PRIORITIES: This turn, play Zagoth Triome tapped. Nothing in hand is castable: Braids needs BB, and Doc Aurlock needs G and U. Next turn, play Forest for 5 mana (Swamp, Triome, Forest, Sol Ring). Cast Sheoldred with BB from Swamp and Triome; if she costs more than 5, cast Syr Konrad instead. The turn after, play Island and cast Muldrotha (Swamp B, Forest G, Island U, plus Triome and Sol Ring). After that, cast Braids and Doc Aurlock with spare mana.

THREAT: P2's Giada is live, and angels will snowball. P3 Edgar makes vampire tokens through eminence even uncast. Save the first removal for Giada or the vampire anthem.

HOLD: Don't sacrifice to Braids early. Save Syr Konrad for when the graveyard lanes start churning.

PRIORITIES: We have no land to play, so ramp is everything. This turn, cast Wayfarer's Bauble (1), then Spore Frog (G) with the other mana. Next turn, crack the Bauble (2, tap, sacrifice) for a basic. If we draw a land, play it first, then cast Doc Aurlock with the spare mana. Grist (3) comes next once we have 3 lands; tick it up to make Insects for board presence and self-mill. Recast Seal of Primordium from the graveyard only after Muldrotha is out.

THREAT: Skullclamp appears gone. The board is empty and everyone is land-light. P1's Sauron is the top threat once cast. P2's Nykthos becomes explosive with devotion, so save removal for it.

HOLD: Kaya's Ghostform stays for Muldrotha. Hold Coming of Galactus and Syr Konrad until 5+ mana. Save Spore Frog's fog for a big swing.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Marsh Flats and fetch a Swamp now; the fetch in the graveyard can be replayed later with Muldrotha. 2) Tap and sacrifice Ratchet Bomb at 1 to destroy both Sol Rings; this also stocks our artifact lane. 3) Cast Plaguecrafter, sacrificing itself; it kills Ramunap plus one of P3's creatures. 4) Cast Cryogen Relic with the remaining mana. Next turn play Forest, then cast Muldrotha at 6 lands.
THREAT: P3 Giada's angels are the leader. P2 Ramunap can recur lands. P1 Teval can exile graveyards; watch its mana.
HOLD: Counterspell needs UU and we have only one blue source (Tropical Island), so it is uncastable. Keep Twisted Embrace for Giada or a big angel. Hold Barrin.

PRIORITIES: Play Swamp now. It is our only untapped mana (B), so pass unless a threat needs answering. Next turn with 4 lands, cast Grist (1BG, Overgrown Tomb is our only green) and use +1 to mill and make Insects. Spend the spare B on Kaya's Ghostform only if Grist needs protecting. Following turn: Spore Frog plus Doc Aurlock. Aim for 6 lands and Muldrotha, then recast Wayfarer's Bauble and Seal of Primordium from the graveyard.

THREAT: The board is empty. P3's Talisman gives them a mana lead, so watch Y'shtola. Sauron is still the top threat. Save Seal of Primordium for Nykthos-fueled enchantments or artifacts.

HOLD: Galactus and Syr Konrad until 5+ lands. Spore Frog's fog is for a real swing.

PRIORITIES: Play Bayou now; it enters untapped, so you have 5 mana (Swamp, Triome, Bayou, Sol Ring for 2). Cast Sheoldred, paying BB from Swamp and Bayou and generic from Sol Ring. If she costs more than 5, cast Syr Konrad instead. Next turn, play Island (6 mana) and cast Muldrotha: B from Swamp, G from Bayou, U from Island, generic from Triome and Sol Ring. Doc Aurlock needs U, so he waits for the Island. Hold Forest as the spare land drop.

THREAT: P2's Gisela (4/3 flying first strike) plus Giada angels. P3 has 7 cards and Edgar eminence. The first removal goes to Gisela or Giada.

HOLD: Braids until there is sac fodder. Don't overextend into wipes from P2 or P3.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Forest. 2) If you have 6 mana with B, G and U available, cast Muldrotha now (Woodland Cemetery for B, Tropical Island for U, Forest for G). 3) If you can't make 6, cast Plaguecrafter (kills Ramunap, Stitcher's Supplier and one P3 creature), then Seal of Doom. 4) Next turn, from the graveyard: recast Ratchet Bomb (artifact lane) and Plaguecrafter or Seal of Doom. Save Seal of Doom for Gisela.
THREAT: P3 Gisela (flying, first strike, lifelink) plus Giada angels lead the table. P2 Ramunap recurs lands. P1 Teval can exile our graveyard.
HOLD: Correction: Counterspell is castable (Tropical Island plus Watery Grave). Keep UU up for graveyard hate or a wipe once Muldrotha lands. Hold Twisted Embrace, Barrin and Vraska.

PRIORITIES: No land in hand, so use all 4 mana this turn. Tap Overgrown Tomb (G), Underground Sea (B) and Island to cast Grist, the Hunger Tide. Use +1 to mill 1 and make an Insect. Then use Swamp for Kaya's Ghostform on Grist. Next turn: cast Arcane Signet first, then Spore Frog or Doc Aurlock. Ramp toward 6 mana for Muldrotha.

THREAT: Sephiroth (P2) is the only creature on the board, and Nykthos can explode. Once an Insect exists, Grist -2 (sacrifice the Insect) destroys Sephiroth if he starts growing or draining. Sauron is still the long-game threat.

HOLD: Spore Frog for a lethal-sized swing. Save Galactus and Syr Konrad until 6+ mana. Save Seal of Primordium's recast for a real artifact or enchantment.

PRIORITIES: Play Island now for 6 mana. Cast Muldrotha: B from Swamp, G from Bayou, U from Island, 1 from Triome, 2 from Sol Ring. Next turn, play Forest (7 mana). Then cast Nature's Lore for a Forest-typed dual or Forest, followed by Syr Konrad or Doc Aurlock. Start filling the graveyard lanes as soon as you can.

THREAT: P2's Lyra Dawnbringer (5/5 flying, first strike, lifelink) is the top target. She outraces our drain and none of our creatures can block her. P3 holds 7 cards with Edgar eminence, so expect a vampire go-wide turn.

HOLD: Braids until there is spare sac fodder. Keep Sheoldred home as a blocker. Don't dump the hand into a P2 or P3 wipe.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play a land if you drew one. 2) This turn, cast nothing and keep Tropical Island plus Watery Grave up for Counterspell. 3) If Counterspell goes unused by the last opponent's end step, pay {1}{U} to sacrifice Cryogen Relic and draw. 4) Next turn with 6 lands, cast Muldrotha, then recast Ratchet Bomb from the graveyard. With only 5 lands, cast Vraska, Golgari Queen or Seal of Doom and keep Counterspell up if you can.
THREAT: Boards are empty; watch what lands next. P3's Smothering Tithe ramps them into Giada angels. P1's Teval can exile our graveyard. P1's Awaken the Honored Dead recurs threats.
HOLD: Counterspell for a board wipe, graveyard hate or a big threat. Hold Seal of Doom, Twisted Embrace and Barrin until a real creature appears.

PRIORITIES:
1. Cast Arcane Signet first (2 mana; it nets back 1, leaving 3).
2. Grist, the Hunger Tide: +1 (mill 1, make an Insect) unless Sephiroth needs the -2 now.
3. Cast Doc Aurlock with the remaining mana. Put the last colored mana into Siren Stormtamer to protect Grist.
4. Next turn, aim for 6 mana and cast Muldrotha. Then replay the Swamp from the graveyard and recast Seal of Primordium as needed.

THREAT: Sephiroth (P2) with Nykthos. Use Grist -2 (sacrifice the Insect) to kill him once he grows or starts draining. Sauron (P1) is the long-term threat, and the Nazgûl are growing.

HOLD: Spore Frog if Stormtamer is cast. Syr Konrad and Galactus until after Muldrotha.

PRIORITIES: Play Forest. Cast Nature's Lore using Forest (G) and Triome, and fetch an untapped Forest. Then cast Muldrotha: B from Swamp, G from the new Forest, U from Island, and generic from Bayou plus Sol Ring. Next turn, use Muldrotha's creature lane to recast Sheoldred from the graveyard, then add Syr Konrad or Dalek Drone from hand.

THREAT: Every opponent's board is empty; Lyra is gone. P3 (Edgar, 6 cards, 5 lands) can go wide with vampires quickly, so answer that first. P2's Giada deck with 6 Plains may hold a wipe. P1's Teval deck will fill its graveyard.

HOLD: Braids until you have sac fodder. Doc Aurlock and a second creature should wait until Muldrotha survives a turn cycle. Commit at most two threats at once.

PRIORITIES: 1) Cast Seal of Doom and sacrifice it right away to destroy P3's Lyra Dawnbringer. 2) Play a land if you draw one. 3) With the leftover mana, pay {1}{U} at the last opponent's end step to sacrifice Cryogen Relic and draw. 4) Next turn, cast Muldrotha, then recast Seal of Doom and Cryogen Relic from the graveyard. With spare mana, also recast Ratchet Bomb.
THREAT: P3's Lyra plus Smothering Tithe leads into Giada angels. P1's Teval can exile our graveyard. P1's Awaken the Honored Dead recurs threats. P2's Zuran Orb gives them life.
HOLD: Vraska, Golgari Queen until after Muldrotha. Hold Barrin, Twisted Embrace and Kaya's Ghostform. Put Ghostform on Muldrotha once he lands.

PRIORITIES:
1. Cast Muldrotha with all 6 mana: tap the 4 lands and filter through Arcane Signet.
2. Play Swamp from the graveyard as your land drop, using the land lane. Flip the land die.
3. With that 1 mana, cast Wayfarer's Bauble from the graveyard using the artifact lane. Next turn, crack it for a land to ramp toward Seal plus Bauble every turn.
4. Grist +1 to mill and make an Insect. Keep loyalty up.

THREAT: Sauron (P1). March from the Black Gate and the growing Nazgûl will go wide. Next turn, recast Seal of Primordium and pop it on March. Y'shtola (P3) is the secondary threat. P2 has an empty board, so ignore P2.

HOLD: Siren Stormtamer to counter any removal aimed at Muldrotha. Hold Spore Frog, Survival, Syr Konrad and Galactus; there is no mana this turn.

PRIORITIES: Play Bloodstained Mire and crack it for a basic Swamp (pay 1 life). This puts Mire in the graveyard so Muldrotha can replay it later. Cast Muldrotha: B from Swamp, G from Forest, U from Island, generic from Triome, Bayou and Breeding Pool. Put Kaya's Ghostform on Muldrotha using B from the new Swamp. Next turn: recast Sol Ring through the artifact lane, Sheoldred through the creature lane, and replay Mire through the land lane.

THREAT: P2's Archangel of Thune (lifelink anthem) is the top priority. Edgar (P3) comes next. Massacre Wurm only kills Shigeki now, so hold it.

HOLD: Massacre Wurm, Syr Konrad, Doc Aurlock and Dalek Drone. Don't sacrifice to Braids this turn; decline her trigger.

PRIORITIES: 1) Cast Muldrotha with your 6 mana. 2) Play Marsh Flats from the graveyard as your land drop. Crack it for a black source. 3) Cast Kaya's Ghostform from hand on Muldrotha with that mana. 4) Next turn, use the enchantment lane to recast Seal of Doom and kill Korvold (or Valkyrie Harbinger if it's swinging at us). Use the artifact lane for Ratchet Bomb, left at 0 to wipe the tokens later. Use the creature lane for Plaguecrafter. Then cast Hostage Taker from hand on whatever remains.

THREAT: P2's Korvold snowballs cards. P3's Harbinger, Smothering Tithe and Giada build an angel army. P1's Teval can exile our graveyard.

HOLD: Vraska, Golgari Queen for a -3 on a key 3-drop. Hold Twisted Embrace and Barrin as backups.

PRIORITIES:
1. Cast Muldrotha from the command zone with all 6 mana. Tap 3 lands, and tap the 4th into Arcane Signet.
2. Play Swamp from the graveyard (land lane). Tap it for Wayfarer's Bauble from the graveyard (artifact lane). Flip both dice.
3. Grist +1: mill, make an Insect.
4. Next turn: Seal of Doom from hand on Sauron, and Seal of Primordium from the graveyard on March from the Black Gate.

THREAT: P1's Sauron (7/6) plus the Orc Army is the main threat. Chump Sauron with the Insect if needed. P2 now has Vrock and Pitiless Plunderer, a sacrifice-value engine, so watch it. P3's Y'shtola is the secondary threat.

HOLD: Siren Stormtamer to protect Muldrotha. Hold Syr Konrad, Survival, Spore Frog and Seal of Doom for mana next turn.

PRIORITIES: 1) Cast Muldrotha (6 mana). If commander tax makes that impossible, cast Vraska, Golgari Queen and -3 Mayhem Devil. 2) Land drop: Marsh Flats from graveyard, crack for Swamp. 3) Kaya's Ghostform (B) on Muldrotha. 4) Next turn: Seal of Doom from graveyard to kill Korvold; Ratchet Bomb (artifact lane), sacrifice at 0 to wipe P1's plants and Witness plus P3's Treasures; Plaguecrafter (creature lane).

THREAT: P2's Korvold draws off every sacrifice, Mayhem Devil pings. P1's Insidious Roots grows a plant army. P3's Angel of Destiny can win at 55+ life. Watch totals.

HOLD: Vraska -3 for Mayhem Devil or Smothering Tithe. Twisted Embrace, Barrin as backup removal. Wayfarer's Bauble when mana is spare.

PRIORITIES:
1. Cast Muldrotha with the six untapped lands: G from Forest, U from Island, B from Watery Grave, and generic from the Triome, Bayou and Breeding Pool.
2. For your land drop, play Bloodstained Mire from the graveyard (land lane). Crack it for a basic Swamp.
3. Use that Swamp to cast Sol Ring from the graveyard (artifact lane).
4. Next turn: Massacre Wurm first, then Sheoldred through the creature lane.

THREAT: P3's Edgar board. The Wurm now kills five creatures: both tokens, Dire Moon, Celebrant and Shigeki. P2's Archangel of Thune is next. Save the Ghostform-proof removal for it.

HOLD: Massacre Wurm (next turn), Syr Konrad and Doc Aurlock. Keep the hand lands and play the graveyard lands first. Decline Braids' trigger.

PRIORITIES:
1. Check Muldrotha's total cost, including commander tax. Our real mana is 5 (4 lands plus Signet, which eats one land). If we can pay her full cost, cast Muldrotha. Then play Swamp from the graveyard and cast Seal of Primordium on March from the Black Gate.
2. If we can't pay for her, cast Spore Frog (G) and keep 1G up for Heroic Intervention.
3. With the 2 spare mana, cast nothing big. Next turn: Muldrotha, then Swamp, Seal of Doom on Sauron, and Grist from the graveyard.

THREAT: P1's Orc Army (11/11) and Sauron. Sacrifice Spore Frog to fog P1's big attack. P2's Vrock and Plunderer are an aristocrats engine. P3 has 7 cards in hand.

HOLD: Heroic Intervention to answer a wipe or removal. Hold Syr Konrad until Muldrotha is on board.

PRIORITIES:
1. Play Wooded Foothills from hand and crack it for a basic. The graveyard lands are dead until Muldrotha lands.
2. Cast Syr Konrad with the 5 untapped lands. Every Wurm or combat death then pings each opponent.
3. Attack P2 with Massacre Wurm and Dalek Drone. P2 must lose life this turn to stop Luminarch Ascension reaching 4 counters. Keep Braids home.
4. Next turn: Talisman, Muldrotha, then graveyard casts (fetch, Sol Ring, Sheoldred).

THREAT: P2's Luminarch Ascension, one counter from making 4/4 angels. P1's Teval board is second.

HOLD: Doc Aurlock, Talisman, Drowned Catacomb. Decline Braids unless P2 took no damage. If not, sacrifice Kaya's Ghostform to force P2 to sacrifice Ascension or lose 2.

PRIORITIES:
1. Play Forest (7 mana). Cast Syr Konrad (3BB). Keep 1G open for Heroic Intervention.
2. Attack P1 (7 life) with Galactus. Any chump block or creature death triggers Konrad damage.
3. Point Galactus's land trigger at our own basic Island (Underground Sea still gives us blue). Never target an opponent's land.
4. Muldrotha waits until we have her full cost plus tax and can still keep Heroic mana open. Then play Swamp from the graveyard, cast Seal of Doom on Sauron, and cast Grist.

THREAT: P1's Orc Army and Sauron; sacrifice Spore Frog to fog their attack. P2's Vrock, Plunderer and Blood Artist drain engine. P3 has 7 cards in hand.

HOLD: Heroic Intervention for a wipe or for removal aimed at Galactus or Konrad.

PRIORITIES: 1) P1 is out. Angel of Destiny is the must-kill: P3 is at 56 (the bar is 55), so Angel attacking us means we lose. Next turn, Twisted Embrace targets Angel first. Backup: Barrin, then {2} and sacrifice Kaya's Ghostform to bounce Angel. 2) This turn, with 2 mana and no land drop, hold. Don't Animate Dead Plaguecrafter; P3 just sacrifices a token-grade body. 3) Cast Muldrotha only after Angel is handled.

THREAT: Angel of Destiny (lethal). Next are Korvold card draw, Mayhem Devil pings, Titania.

HOLD: Vraska, Golgari Queen -3 for Mayhem Devil or Smothering Tithe (Angel's MV is too high). Animate Dead and Vrock stay back until Muldrotha is on board.

PRIORITIES:
1. Play Underground Sea (7 mana). Cast Syr Konrad (5), then Birds of Paradise (1), both before combat.
2. Attack P1 with Braids. P1 is at 3 with no creatures and all lands tapped, so Braids alone is lethal.
3. Backup if P1 survives combat: at the end step, have Braids sacrifice Birds (creature type). P1 has no creature, so P1 loses 2, and Birds dying makes Syr Konrad ping each opponent for 1. That kills P1.
4. Next turn: cast Muldrotha.

THREAT: P1's single card in hand, a fog or flash blocker. After P1, Edgar Markov's vampire army (P3).

HOLD: The Coming of Galactus, Drowned Catacomb, Forest, Island, Command Tower. Keep 1 mana open.

PRIORITIES: 1) Now: cast Twisted Embrace on Hostage Taker and destroy Angel of Destiny. P3 is at 76, so an Angel attack means we lose. This comes first. 2) Then cast Farseek (tapped dual) so we have 8+ mana next turn. 3) Next turn: Muldrotha. Replay Marsh Flats and recast Seal of Doom, then Ratchet Bomb, then Plaguecrafter from graveyard. 4) To close, cast Vraska, Golgari Queen and +2 each turn toward the -9 emblem. Kill Angel of Jubilation and Youthful Valkyrie with recurring Seal of Doom.

THREAT: Angel of Destiny, then the Giada anthem making the fliers bigger. The Treasure from Smothering Tithe lets P3 recast threats.

HOLD: Barrin to bounce any recast Angel. Animate Dead and Vrock wait until Muldrotha is out. Never let Angel attack.

PRIORITIES:
1. If Muldrotha costs 7 or less with tax, cast her now. Then play Swamp from the graveyard as your land drop.
2. Spend the leftover mana in this order: Spore Frog (G) as a fog, then Seal of Doom (2B) on Sephiroth if you still have 3 mana.
3. If Muldrotha costs more than 7, cast Glen Elendra Archmage (3U) and keep 1G up for Heroic Intervention.
4. Next turn, recast Grist and Seal of Doom from the graveyard to kill Blood Artist and Pitiless Plunderer.

THREAT: P2's aristocrats drain: Sephiroth, Blood Artist, Plunderer, Vrock and Plaguecrafter. P3 holds 7 cards. We're at 12 life.

HOLD: Heroic Intervention for a wipe or for removal aimed at Muldrotha.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Overgrown Tomb untapped (pay 2 life) and cast Spore Frog to deter early attacks. 2) Next turn play Bloodstained Mire and crack it. This fetches a dual and puts a land in the graveyard for Muldrotha to replay. Then cast Arcane Signet. 3) Turn 6+: cast Doc Aurlock, then Muldrotha by turn 7 with 6 mana. Play Takenuma last. Its channel ability returns creatures later.

THREAT: P2 (Hearthhull plus a Sol Ring) is the fastest start. Watch for land-sacrifice value. P3 Giada's angel counters snowball, so save removal for those.

HOLD: Keep Gray Merchant until Muldrotha can recur it for repeated drains. Don't sacrifice Spore Frog unless an attack would do real damage.

PRIORITIES:
1. Play Woodland Cemetery. That gives 8 mana with Birds.
2. Cast Muldrotha from the command zone. If commander tax pushes her above 8, cast Vraska, Golgari Queen instead: -3 on Master of Dark Rites (or a Vampire token), then Glen Elendra Archmage.
3. With leftover mana after Muldrotha, hold 2 open and don't cast anything else.
4. Don't attack. Keep Muldrotha, Syr Konrad and Braids home as blockers against P3.
5. End step: skip Braids' sacrifice unless it costs only something expendable.

THREAT: P3's Edgar Markov army, about 20 power in total. P3 is at 17 and holding 5 cards. P2's Giada and Valkyrie are secondary.

HOLD: The Coming of Galactus, Glen Elendra (if Muldrotha resolves), spare lands.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Bloodstained Mire and crack it for an untapped Swamp-type dual (Watery Grave if available). 2) Cast Arcane Signet with that 2 mana, tap Signet for G, then cast Spore Frog. 3) Next turns play Swamp, then Takenuma. At 5 mana, cast Doc Aurlock or Hostage Taker (take a Sol Ring or angel). Muldrotha at 6.

THREAT: P2's Sol Ring gives them the mana lead, so Hostage Taker it if nothing better appears. P3 Giada angels snowball once creatures land; kill the first Giada.

HOLD: Keep Gray Merchant for Muldrotha loops. Sacrifice Spore Frog only against real damage. Keep Takenuma's channel ability for later.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Hinterland Harbor now. It enters tapped anyway, and we have no 1-drop. 2) Next turn, play Watery Grave untapped only if casting something. Otherwise let it enter tapped and skip the 2 life. 3) Hold Bojuka Bog for a graveyard deck or as a land drop when we need nothing else. 4) Curve plan: Eternal Witness later, returning the best spent card. Binding the Old Gods at 4 to ramp and kill. Hostage Taker or Baba Lysaga at 4–5. Muldrotha at 6.

THREAT: P3 Edgar Markov (vampire go-wide) is the top threat. P2 Giada angels are second. Save removal for real threats, not Segovian Angel.

HOLD: Binding the Old Gods chapter I for Edgar's board or Giada.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Swamp this turn (keep Nurturing Peatland and Takenuma for later). Cast Arcane Signet with 2 of the 3 lands. You have no 2-drop, so pass holding 2 open. 2) Next turn play Takenuma, which gives 6 mana, and cast Muldrotha. 3) The turn after, cast Hostage Taker on P2's Sol Ring, or on Giada if she has landed. Then Doc Aurlock.

THREAT: P2's Sol Ring is the fastest mana and the prime Hostage Taker target. Kill Giada the moment P3 casts her. P1's Shigeki is ramping, so watch for big green threats.

HOLD: Keep Gray Merchant for Muldrotha loops. Sacrifice Spore Frog only against real combat damage. Save Takenuma's channel and Peatland's draw for later.

PRIORITIES:
1. Land drop: Swamp from the graveyard. Keep Breeding Pool in hand.
2. Binding the Old Gods (2BG): destroy Sephiroth, not Blood Artist. Blood Artist's death triggers both drains and costs us 2 life; Sephiroth's death costs us 1.
3. Creature lane: Spore Frog (G) for a Syr Konrad ping.
4. Planeswalker lane: Grist (1BG) for another Konrad ping. Use +1 to make an Insect blocker. Don't use −2, since sacrificing feeds Blood Artist.
5. Wayfarer's Bauble with the last mana.

THREAT: We're at 4. Every creature death drains us. P2's fliers and go-wide attack. Teferi means we're sorcery-speed only.

HOLD: Sacrifice Spore Frog to fog P2's combat. Don't chump-block unless it's lethal otherwise.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Watery Grave untapped (pay 2 life). 2) If you then have 4 mana, cast Binding the Old Gods. Chapter I kills Segovian Angel, the only legal target. The ramp matters more than the target. 3) If you have only 3 mana, don't cast Eternal Witness into an empty graveyard; pass holding mana. 4) Next turn: Hostage Taker or Baba Lysaga. Save Bojuka Bog as a later land drop. Muldrotha comes at 6 mana.

THREAT: P3 Edgar Markov (vampire go-wide) is first. P2 Giada angels are second. P1 Teval is quiet for now.

HOLD: Eternal Witness until the graveyard holds something worth returning. Hold Hostage Taker for Edgar's or Giada's best creature, not a 1/1.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Takenuma, Abandoned Mire as your land drop, then cast Muldrotha with all 6 mana. Tomb gives G, Grave gives U. 2) Next turn, fetch with Bloodstained Mire from the graveyard via Muldrotha's land lane.
